labels.inference_memory_total: inference memory with the whole decode cache

ttq.label: training cost as time to quality

stateonly.label: decode state only as memory (OM2 definition)

statetotal.label: whole decode cache as memory (incl. input-independent tables)

latbest.label: best round instead of the median for prefill and decode

pass1.label: timings from the first pass only

pass2.label: timings from the second pass only

latil.label: prefill and decode timed interleaved in one process

timing.rule: median over all valid per-process rounds of both passes (om2g and tfplain: second pass only)

om2g.name: v2 + state-gated exact store ("Mamba-4" idea, gate as designed)
